brief: Clear bird nesting material packed into the upper ventilation grille before the heat event, as clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity when a ventilation obstruction defect is outstanding [SOP-011]. Complete work order WO-3182 for the cooling controller, which remains open from last season, along with remedial actions for the scale build-up across the lower third of the radiator bank and the low conservator oil level [SOP-016].
